reason: The storys 4 acceptance criteria are concrete, narrow, and independently verifiable. The actual code delta is small. The timeout is caused by a transient infra issue: the gotransit develop branch already has 88 pre-existing TypeScript errors from a prior refactoring (AMSD-139) that removed named exports. The tsc gate fails on these pre-existing errors, triggering the self-healing loop. The FailureAnalyst misdiagnosed the root cause twice, burning the time budget on out-of-scope fixes. The SDK type contradiction is solvable with a type cast, not a scope ambiguity.
